name: Join two craft materials
short_description: Make a durable, neat joint between two compatible craft materials and test it ten times.
self_assessment: I can join two craft materials without help and pass ten gentle use tests.
description: Make a durable, neat joint between two compatible craft materials and test it ten times. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Join paperboard and cord in a small model

builds_on.note: Fine motor control supports accurate joining.

safety_note: Cutting tools and adhesives can injure or irritate; use guarded sharp tools, ventilate adhesive work, and follow material handling instructions.
